author: Mantercmg
body:
After a load of work, the map is done! Including the YMLs, the map is ready! (Though I may have messed up the core locations by one block) Big shoutout and thanks to In_Arte for all his help!
Download: http://www.filedropper.com/dtmsolsystem
Everything is in there! Thanks to ParaSpider for his extremely helpful post regarding what they want inside the .zip file!
The majority of the map: 
The Spawn point: (Partially loaded Earth and Neptune included) 

And The red Ship and Red monuments! Reds spawn on board the ship!
And the Red Spawn!The Blue side Now! (Uranus Included)
And their spawn:And Jupiter! Great red spot included! (though hard to notice)So, Anyway, Thank you to whoever commented, and well... I hope this gets excepted! (I shouldn't get my hopes up, but ah well...)

replies.author: _CubeRoot
replies.body:
Dat bump doe :P
As already said, the monuments are really close together, and if that's the spawn in between them, the map won't be playable; A defender dies, and he/she spawns right next to the objective. 
Saturn's rings are further away from the planet than you made them look. They're also normally on a tilt, but that might be a bit hard. Don't forget that Uranus has rings as well, when you make it.
